publicRubrics.title: Public visual quality review

criteria.label: Composition and hierarchy
criteria.instruction: Judge only whether the visible raster has a coherent visual order and emphasis.

anchors.label: Unclear
anchors.description: Visible composition or hierarchy prevents a coherent reading order.

anchors.label: Clear
anchors.description: Visible composition and hierarchy communicate a coherent reading order.

criteria.label: Finish and consistency
criteria.instruction: Judge only visible spacing, alignment, styling consistency, and implementation finish.

anchors.label: Inconsistent
anchors.description: Visible spacing, alignment, or styling contains material inconsistencies.

anchors.label: Consistent
anchors.description: Visible spacing, alignment, and styling are materially consistent.

criteria.label: Legibility and contrast
criteria.instruction: Judge only whether visible content is readable and distinguishable in the supplied raster.

anchors.label: Illegible
anchors.description: Material visible content is unreadable or lacks sufficient distinction.

anchors.label: Legible
anchors.description: Material visible content is readable and sufficiently distinguishable.

accessibilityInstructions: Evaluate the raster at the supplied dimensions without inferring hidden interaction state.
Use the same pass or fail anchors for every randomized presentation.
